**Triage Summary:**

Twenty findings across OpenSSL (libcrypto3/libssl3 3.5.1-r0) and Go stdlib (v1.23.12) are flagged for review. The OpenSSL CVEs are duplicated across libcrypto3 and libssl3 packages but represent 8 distinct vulnerabilities; all are HIGH severity with low-to-moderate EPSS scores (0.009–0.487), none are tracked as KEV, and all have available fixes. One CRITICAL Go stdlib CVE (CVE-2025-68121) and one HIGH (CVE-2025-61726) are also present with fixes available. The actionable risk is concentrated in the OpenSSL library version; the Go stdlib CRITICAL warrants immediate attention despite low EPSS.

**Recommended Action:** Approve the upgrade of libcrypto3/libssl3 to the patched version and stdlib to v1.23.12+ to resolve all findings. Prioritize the Go stdlib CRITICAL fix in deployment. No blockers present given fix availability and absence of active exploitation signals.
